feeding_claim.verbatim: Seawind Meadows, LLC is a family-owned and operated grass-fed and grass-finished Highland beef producer.

farmers_markets: Orleans Farmers Market, 19 Old Colony Way, Orleans (Saturdays 9am to 12pm, May to November)
Orleans Winter Farmers Market, Lower Cape TV, 5 Namskaket Road, Orleans (twice a month, Saturdays 10am to 12pm, December to April)
notes: Scout 2026-11-25: read the seawindmeadows.com homepage, Beef for Sale and Contact pages. Scottish Highland cattle on Cape Cod in Dennis; no street address or zip on the site. Beef is sold at the Orleans Farmers Market (high-end steaks only there) and at two retail stores: Orleans Whole Food Store (46 Main Street, Orleans) and Cape Abilities Farmstand (458 Main Street, Route 6A, Dennis); Verifier: these stores may sell the beef, not just pickup. Eggs sold at the market. Phone (508) 776-7150 is on the Contact page. No online ordering, bulk shares, delivery or shipping mentioned; email for information. Also sells registered Highland breeding stock.
